title: Boss Rush: every boss, back to back
description: A new mode next to Free Run and the Daily: the bosses of all five maps in a row, Exit Liquidity included, with a breather and a level-up between each fight, its own board label and its own missions.

title: Story Mode: Chapter 1
description: Five short stages in a row, each with its own goal, a story card between them and a portal at the end that warps you to the next, ending in a boss fight.

title: The Dev: a fifth character who ships turrets
description: A new playable character, unlocked in the Market: the Dev deploys little smart-contract turrets that hold the line while you kite, with an animated sprite, a trait, missions and a select card.
